title: VaultState
description: On-chain state of one vault, read by the harness and rendered by the dApp. Invariant: the vault is SOLE CUSTODIAN (Pattern 1). Capital never leaves it — Aqua tracks virtual balances while the tokens stay put — so holdings[] is literally the vault's token balances and total_assets is derived from them.

asset.description: ERC-4626 accounting asset (USDC on Base for the demo).

total_assets.description: totalAssets() — base-asset balance plus non-base holdings valued via Chainlink Base feeds. Single source of truth for share pricing.

share_price.description: convertToAssets(1e18) as a decimal string. Decimal, not float — precision matters here.

holdings.description: Every token the vault holds. Under Pattern 1 this is the complete picture, including capital committed to Aqua strategies.

value_in_asset.description: Valued in base asset via the same Chainlink feed totalAssets() uses, so the UI and the contract never disagree.

committed_to_venue.description: Venue key if this balance backs an open position (e.g. 'aqua'). Still custodied by the vault — this flags encumbrance, not location.

agent.description: Holder of AGENT_ROLE. This key executes directly with no human override — that is the trust model, stated plainly.

mandate_hash.description: keccak256 of the canonical mandate JSON, recorded at genesis. Lets a depositor verify the off-chain mandate they were shown is the one the vault was created with.

aqua_strategies.description: Open Aqua positions. Informational — these do NOT move assets out of the vault.
